brief:
US President Donald Trump praised his envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff for their work on Gaza ceasefire negotiations, telling reporters there is "not a lot of fighting in Gaza" and that the pair are "doing a great" job, Middle East Eye reported.

Trump's comments reflected his administration's push to broker a ceasefire deal in the territory, where fighting between Israel and Hamas has persisted since October 2023.
dek: 'Not a lot of fighting in Gaza': Trump praises Kushner, Witkoff US president Donald Trump has credited his envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, with “doing a great” job in Gaza ceasefire negotiations.
title: Trump credits envoys Kushner and Witkoff with Gaza ceasefire progress
